meta.text: The third problem changes shape. A colleague's notebook, whose default language is Python, suddenly fails. The hint tells you nothing about the SQL actually changed — the session did. The method here is to reason about scope: Databricks binds a Spark session and its temp views to the notebook and cluster, so when the session context shifts, previously registered views can disappear. That is exactly the kind of scope reasoning the exam rewards. Keep these three patterns in mind, and the next checkpoint will feel straightforward.
